info.title: LEA API
info.description: Learning Engagement Assistant: chat, tutor and quiz modes over one adaptive learner model. Authenticate with `POST /auth/login` and send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.description: Courses a new account can enrol in (no login needed).

schema.title: Response My Courses Me Courses Get

post.description: Enroll yourself in one more course, from GET /courses. Idempotent.

schema.title: Response Add My Course Me Courses Post

delete.description: Un-enrol yourself from a course. Your progress in it isn't deleted.

schema.title: Response Remove My Course Me Courses  Code  Delete

get.description: Mastery of each objective in the week against its own threshold.

parameters.name: week

schema.description: Week to report (the progress screen's current week)
schema.title: Week

parameters.description: Week to report (the progress screen's current week)

schema.title: Response History Chat  Code  Messages Get

post.description: Ask a question; the reply comes back when complete. See ``/messages/stream``.

200.description: Server-sent events: `token` ({text}) while the model writes, then `done` (ChatReply) or `error` ({detail, code, status}).

post.description: Start a quiz on the week, or return the one already in progress for it.
Answer the current question. The response has status ``feedback``.
After feedback: the next question, or the results (status ``completed``).

Start a session on the week (or return the one running for it). The first tutor
message asks what the student already knows. With ``review_quiz`` and a finished quiz on
the same week, a fresh session starts that knows the quiz results (``quiz_review`` in the
answer says whether it did); otherwise this is an ordinary start.

200.description: Server-sent events: `token` ({text}) while the tutor writes, then `done` (TutorReplyOut) or `error` ({detail, code, status}).

get.description: The courses the caller owns; for an admin, every course (installed, set up or owned).

schema.title: Response My Courses Teach Courses Get

post.description:
Set up a new course. A teacher who creates it owns it. Students don't see it until a
KC model is published for it.

put.description: The weekly learning objectives the KC model is drafted from (every week, 1-12 each).

schema.title: Response Uploads Teach Courses  Code  Uploads Get

post.description:
Upload course materials: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, MD, TXT, IPYNB, MP3, MP4, WAV; at most
50 MB each and 1 GB per course. A file with the same name replaces the old one. All
files are checked before any is kept, file by file: the first bad file stops the rest.

schema.title: Response Add Uploads Teach Courses  Code  Uploads Post

get.description: Subfolders under LEA_COURSE_MATERIALS_ROOT, for the "link a folder" picker.

schema.title: Response Materials Folders Teach Materials Folders Get
Response Materials Source Teach Courses  Code  Materials Source Get

post.description:
Link a read-only folder under LEA_COURSE_MATERIALS_ROOT. A Build job then ingests its
files alongside any uploads -- see GET .../materials-source/sync-preview.

delete.description: Stop tracking the link. Files already ingested from it stay as ordinary uploads.

get.description:
What the next Build job would pick up from the linked folder: each file as new,
changed, unchanged, removed or rejected (with why). Read-only -- changes nothing.
The course's recent jobs, newest first (without their logs).

schema.title: Response Jobs Teach Courses  Code  Jobs Get

post.description:
Prepare an onboarding run and price it. Nothing runs (and nothing is spent) until
`POST /teach/jobs/{id}/confirm`. One job per course at a time (409 otherwise).

get.description: Status, progress, estimate, result and the latest log lines. Poll while it runs.

post.description: Accept the estimate and queue the job.
Cancel: at once if it hasn't started, otherwise after the current file.

get.description: Published versions (the live one marked) and the draft, if any.

post.description:
Start the draft from the live model or an onboarding job's draft (409 if a draft
exists, unless ``replace``).

get.description: The draft's rows (one per granular objective) and any problems with them.

put.description: Replace the draft's rows. New rows get IDs; nothing is saved if any row has an error.

post.description: Check rows without saving them.

200.description: The draft (or the live model) as a spreadsheet

post.description:
Read an edited spreadsheet into the draft. It is validated first: with any error,
nothing changes and the problems are listed. Returns the draft and its diff.

get.description: What publishing the draft would change, and how many students it affects.

post.description:
Publish the draft as the next version: students see it at once. Mastery follows the
lineage (splits copy it to each part, merges take the mean); retired objectives keep
their mastery but no longer count.

Start or resume "Try as a student": a token for your sandbox student account
(<you>.preview), enrolled in this course. Everything it does is tagged test and never
reaches research logs, analytics or exports.
Forget what the sandbox did in this course (mastery, sessions, chat), to start over.

get.description:
Why LEA did what it did on your latest preview turns, newest first: the objective,
mastery before and after, grading, the learner model's state, the scaffolding and the
course content retrieved. Only for your own sandbox; students never receive this.

schema.title: Response Preview Explain Teach Courses  Code  Preview Explain Get

get.description: Things to try in a preview of the week.

schema.title: Response Preview Probes Teach Courses  Code  Preview Probes Get

get.description:
The latest audit with each finding's decision, what's new since the run before, and
what that run found that this one doesn't (null before the first run).

schema.title: Response Audit Latest Teach Courses  Code  Audit Get

get.description: What running the audit costs (only coverage and redundancy use OpenAI).

schema.title: Response Audit Runs Teach Courses  Code  Audit Runs Get

post.description:
Audit the live version: accessibility of the files, question writing, Bloom balance,
coverage, redundancy, prerequisite order, alignment, readability. Findings are ranked
(at most 15 per check); earlier decisions carry over.

put.description: Accept or dismiss a finding (with an optional note), or reopen it.

get.description:
Each objective's mastery band, students, first-attempt accuracy, attempts to master,
learning-curve verdict and "needs attention" score (LEA's heuristic, with the factor
that drove it), most in need first; then usage. Real students only by default; figures
from fewer than 5 students are withheld.

post.description:
Draft a short explanation of the objective from the course material, for the
teacher to edit. LEA never publishes it.

get.description:
Every objective of the live version with the videos chosen for it, and the state of
automatic YouTube search (paused when its daily quota is used up).

post.description:
Add a YouTube video to an objective (up to 5). The video is checked with YouTube, which
also supplies its title and channel. The tutor shows an objective's videos, in this order,
to a student who is stuck, instead of searching.
Move a video up or down in the objective's list; the first three are what students see.

schema.title: Response Move Video Teach Courses  Code  Videos  Go Id   Video Id  Move Post

get.description: Every account, with its role, status and the courses it owns.

post.description: Create a teacher (or admin) account. There is no self-service teacher sign-up.

patch.description:
Change an account's role, deactivate it (which signs it out everywhere) or reactivate
it, or mark it a test account. The last active admin can't be demoted or deactivated.

put.description: Enroll any account in a course on their behalf. Idempotent.

delete.description: Un-enrol any account from a course. Their progress in it isn't deleted.

put.description: Make a teacher an owner of the course (they must already be a teacher or admin).

key.title: Key
key.description: Stable across runs: the same problem keeps its key

check.title: Check
check.description: accessibility, questions, bloom, coverage, redundancy, prerequisites, alignment, readability

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: How well this kind of check is validated

new.title: New
new.description: Not in the run before this one

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Checks that couldn't run, and why

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Lecture, Lab, Reading, Assignment, Transcript, Video, Audio or Other (default: from the file type)

week.title: Week
week.description: The week the student is studying (context for the answer)

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.description: Share of questions two independent passes mapped to the same objective

usd.title: Usd
usd.description: Upper-end estimate of the OpenAI cost

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.description: computing, mathematics, science, engineering, social_science, humanities, business, health, education, arts or other

error_rate.title: Error Rate
error_rate.description: Null when fewer than 5 students reached this opportunity

source.title: Source
source.description: 'published', or 'job:<id>' for an onboarding job's draft

based_on.title: Based On
based_on.description: The published version the draft started from

correct.title: Correct
correct.description: None when the answer couldn't be graded (it doesn't count)

correct_answer.title: Correct Answer
correct_answer.description: After answering, for multiple choice (the option letter) and true/false

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Students with mastery on retired, split or merged objectives

row.title: Row
row.description: 1-based row, or null for the whole model

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: source, based_on, updated_at, saves; null if none

cognitive_level.title: Cognitive Level
cognitive_level.description: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate or Create

split_from.title: Split From
split_from.description: A published GO this new row replaces (with its other parts)

merged_from.title: Merged From
merged_from.description: Published GOs this new row replaces

KCRow.title: KCRow
KCRow.description:
One granular objective in a KC draft. Leave go_id (and lo_id, for a new learning
objective) empty for new rows: LEA assigns IDs.

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until the token expires if unused; each use renews it

course_curve.title: Course Curve
course_curve.description: Every objective pooled: the course's typical curve

suggestion.title: Suggestion
suggestion.description: A drafted note for the teacher; never applied by LEA

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.description: None until the learner has a graded answer on it

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Mastery needed for this objective (from the KC model)

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: In the order students see them (the first three are shown)

student_gets.title: Student Gets
student_gets.description: What a stuck student is shown: the instructor's videos, an automatic YouTube search, or generic search links (no API key, or search is paused because the daily quota is used up)

help_shown_students.title: Help Shown Students
help_shown_students.description: Real students shown video help here in the last 30 days: 0 if none, null when 1 to 4 (withheld, as in Analytics)

token.title: Token
token.description: Use it for the student endpoints while previewing; keep your own for /teach

version.title: Version
version.description: The published KC version the preview uses

managed.title: Managed
managed.description: Set up in the Teacher area (uploads and jobs); false for courses onboarded by hand

active_job.title: Active Job
active_job.description: The job using the course now, if any

has_kc_model.title: Has Kc Model
has_kc_model.description: A published KC model is installed

prompt_chars.title: Prompt Chars
prompt_chars.description: Characters in what the student was answering

elapsed_ms.title: Elapsed Ms
elapsed_ms.description: Time on task in this session so far

effort_rating.title: Effort Rating
effort_rating.description: Compared with the last objective: -2 much easier .. 2 much harder

TimingIn.title: TimingIn
TimingIn.description:
What the client measured about how the answer was given. All optional; used only to estimate
cognitive load (see src/core/cognitive_load.py). Times are milliseconds.

review_quiz.title: Review Quiz
review_quiz.description: Review the student's just-finished quiz on this week: the tutor starts a fresh session that knows what they got right and wrong

scaffolding_level.title: Scaffolding Level
scaffolding_level.description: Support intensity: very_high, high, medium, low or minimal

scaffolding_strategy.title: Scaffolding Strategy
scaffolding_strategy.description: How the tutor is scaffolding: conceptual, procedural, strategic or metacognitive

quiz_review.title: Quiz Review
quiz_review.description: The session is reviewing a quiz the student just took

current_objective_mastery.title: Current Objective Mastery
current_objective_mastery.description: Debug/monitoring (temporary): the current objective's mastery level, 0-1

cognitive_load.title: Cognitive Load
cognitive_load.description: Debug/monitoring (temporary): the learner's cognitive load as of the last turn

zpd_score.title: Zpd Score
zpd_score.description: Debug/monitoring (temporary): the learner's ZPD score as of the last turn

linked_relpath.title: Linked Relpath
linked_relpath.description: Set when this upload came from a linked materials source, its path there

active.title: Active
active.description: false deactivates the account and signs it out everywhere

session_kind.title: Session Kind
session_kind.description: test: the account's activity stays out of research logs, analytics and exports

go_id.title: Go Id
go_id.description: The objective the video helps with

url.title: Url
url.description: A YouTube video link (watch, youtu.be, embed or shorts)

note.title: Note
note.description: Shown to the student under the link, e.g. 'Watch from 3:20' (up to 200 characters)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Is automatic YouTube search configured (an API key is set)?

quota_paused_until.title: Quota Paused Until
quota_paused_until.description: Automatic search is paused until then: YouTube's daily quota is used up

cached_searches.title: Cached Searches
cached_searches.description: Objectives whose search results are cached for a week

help_shown_times.title: Help Shown Times
help_shown_times.description: Times video help was shown to real students in that window; null when fewer than 5 students

completion.title: Completion
completion.description: Share of the week's objectives mastered (0-1)

WeekMastery.title: WeekMastery
WeekMastery.description: Mastery of each granular objective in one week, grouped by learning objective.
